name: Tulum Archaeological Site
shortDescription: Mayan ruins perched on cliffs overlooking the Caribbean, where ancient history meets turquoise waters.
description: Tulum stands as one of the few Mayan cities built on the coast, offering a unique perspective on how the Maya integrated their architecture with the natural landscape. The site's strategic location suggests it was an important trading port, and the view from the cliff-top temples remains one of the most photographed scenes in the Riviera Maya.
